component.name: Easy NATS
component.summary: Desktop GUI client for NATS and JetStream

description.p: Easy NATS is a desktop client for NATS servers, JetStream, KV, and Object Store.
It provides a tabbed UI for publishing, subscribing, browsing streams and consumers, and managing KV and object store buckets.

screenshot.caption: Main workspace showing connections, stream browsing, and publish controls

description.p: Adds a Test Connection button with inline results to the connection editor, masks token input, and polishes empty states, tab titles, timestamps, stream panel sizing, error toast duration, and disabled-widget contrast.
Expands the interactive demo with searchable sample data and fixes CJK rendering in KV editors and JSON previews.
Theme-aware JSON payload syntax highlighting now follows the selected application theme, and Subscriber payload previews use the available detail space.
Hides KV/Object backing streams from the Streams sidebar by default, with a Settings toggle to show them.
Search Workspace preview now shows the value for Key matches and payload for Subject matches.
Adds scoped request/reply debugging with subscriber replies.
Adds MessagePack payload input and display.
Closes connection-bound tabs on disconnect.
Adds formatted Search Workspace result previews.
Fixes saved theme selection when opening the app.
Fixes KV value and history panel sizing.
Fixes KV key list scrolling in narrow panes.
Improves search performance for large in-memory data sets.
Fixes search source chip layout.
Adds the client status tab.
Improves large KV lists and work queue previews.
Fixes release tag handling in CI.
Adds deliver policies, KV values, and typed backend models.
Adds message schema management and payload templates.
Adds the in-memory search workspace.
Adds scoped tab search.
